entries.name: GStreamer
entries.description: GStreamer core libraries from the Ubuntu 24.04 build host, bundled in the AppImage so WebKitGTK can play video in watch parties. The .deb, .rpm and Arch packages do not contain GStreamer; they depend on the distribution's packages.

entries.name: GStreamer Bad Plugins (opusparse)
entries.description: Only the Opus parser of gst-plugins-bad, bundled in the AppImage: without it WebKit reports no playable audio format for YouTube.

entries.name: GStreamer Base Plugins
entries.description: The plugins of gst-plugins-base, bundled in the AppImage.

entries.name: GStreamer Good Plugins
entries.description: The plugins of gst-plugins-good, bundled in the AppImage. Plugins that implement H.264 and H.265 (gst-libav / FFmpeg, x264, x265, OpenH264) and GPL-only codecs (a52dec, dtsdec, mpeg2dec, libdvdread, faac, faad) are deliberately not bundled (scripts/filter-gst-plugins.sh); the AppImage plays YouTube through VP9.

entries.name: libopus
entries.description: Opus voice codec, compiled from the source vendored by the opusic-sys crate.

entries.name: libvpx
entries.description: VP9 (and VP8) screen-share encoder and decoder, linked by crates/screenshare. Statically linked into the Windows app (vcpkg build) and the macOS and Linux apps (built from the libvpx release source), so it is part of every Mumcord build.

entries.name: linux-raw-sys
entries.license: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT

entries.name: Mumble protocol and plugin interface
entries.description: The protocol definition files in proto/ (Mumble.proto, MumbleUDP.proto) are taken from the Mumble project. The official Mumble game plugins that Mumcord can load at runtime to read game positions are developed by the Mumble project under the same license; they are not part of this repository. Mumcord's plugin host (crates/positional/src/plugins/) follows the plugin interface definitions of the Mumble project (MumblePlugin.h and the headers it includes). Mumcord is compatible with Mumble but is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Mumble project.

entries.name: PipeWire and libspa
entries.description: Wayland screen capture and audio on Linux. Loaded from the system (the AppImage uses the host's PipeWire daemon).

entries.name: rustix
entries.license: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT

entries.name: SQLite
entries.description: Compiled in by libsqlite3-sys (feature "bundled", via rusqlite) and statically linked into Mumcord.

entries.name: WebKitGTK and JavaScriptCoreGTK
entries.description: The web view that renders Mumcord's interface on Linux. Bundled in the AppImage from the Ubuntu 24.04 build host.

#include "SigProc_FIX.h"

opus_int32 silk_inner_prod_aligned_scale(
    const opus_int16 *const     inVec1,             /*    I input vector 1                                              */
    const opus_int16 *const     inVec2,             /*    I input vector 2                                              */
    const opus_int              scale,              /*    I number of bits to shift                                     */
    const opus_int              len                 /*    I vector lengths                                              */
)
{
    opus_int   i;
    opus_int32 sum = 0;
    for( i = 0; i < len; i++ ) {
        sum = silk_ADD_RSHIFT32( sum, silk_SMULBB( inVec1[ i ], inVec2[ i ] ), scale );
    }
    return sum;
}

#include "main_FIX.h"

/* Add noise to matrix diagonal */
void silk_regularize_correlations_FIX(
    opus_int32                      *XX,                                    /* I/O  Correlation matrices                                                        */
    opus_int32                      *xx,                                    /* I/O  Correlation values                                                          */
    opus_int32                      noise,                                  /* I    Noise to add                                                                */
    opus_int                        D                                       /* I    Dimension of XX                                                             */
)
{
    opus_int i;
    for( i = 0; i < D; i++ ) {
        matrix_ptr( &XX[ 0 ], i, i, D ) = silk_ADD32( matrix_ptr( &XX[ 0 ], i, i, D ), noise );
    }
    xx[ 0 ] += noise;
}

#ifndef SILK_SIGPROC_FIX_ARMv5E_H
#define SILK_SIGPROC_FIX_ARMv5E_H

#undef silk_SMULTT
static OPUS_INLINE opus_int32 silk_SMULTT_armv5e(opus_int32 a, opus_int32 b)
{
  opus_int32 res;
  __asm__(
      "#silk_SMULTT\n\t"
      "smultt %0, %1, %2\n\t"
      : "=r"(res)
      : "%r"(a), "r"(b)
  );
  return res;
}
#define silk_SMULTT(a, b) (silk_SMULTT_armv5e(a, b))

#undef silk_SMLATT
static OPUS_INLINE opus_int32 silk_SMLATT_armv5e(opus_int32 a, opus_int32 b,
 opus_int32 c)
{
  opus_int32 res;
  __asm__(
      "#silk_SMLATT\n\t"
      "smlatt %0, %1, %2, %3\n\t"
      : "=r"(res)
      : "%r"(b), "r"(c), "r"(a)
  );
  return res;
}
#define silk_SMLATT(a, b, c) (silk_SMLATT_armv5e(a, b, c))

#endif

#include "SigProc_FIX.h"
/* Approximation of 128 * log2() (very close inverse of silk_log2lin()) */
/* Convert input to a log scale    */
opus_int32 silk_lin2log(
    const opus_int32            inLin               /* I  input in linear scale                                         */
)
{
    opus_int32 lz, frac_Q7;

    silk_CLZ_FRAC( inLin, &lz, &frac_Q7 );

    /* Piece-wise parabolic approximation */
    return silk_ADD_LSHIFT32( silk_SMLAWB( frac_Q7, silk_MUL( frac_Q7, 128 - frac_Q7 ), 179 ), 31 - lz, 7 );
}

#include "SigProc_FIX.h"
#include "celt_lpc.h"

/* Compute autocorrelation */
void silk_autocorr(
    opus_int32                  *results,           /* O    Result (length correlationCount)                            */
    opus_int                    *scale,             /* O    Scaling of the correlation vector                           */
    const opus_int16            *inputData,         /* I    Input data to correlate                                     */
    const opus_int              inputDataSize,      /* I    Length of input                                             */
    const opus_int              correlationCount,   /* I    Number of correlation taps to compute                       */
    int                         arch                /* I    Run-time architecture                                       */
)
{
    opus_int   corrCount;
    corrCount = silk_min_int( inputDataSize, correlationCount );
    *scale = _celt_autocorr(inputData, results, NULL, 0, corrCount-1, inputDataSize, arch);
}

#include "main_FLP.h"

/* Add noise to matrix diagonal */
void silk_regularize_correlations_FLP(
    silk_float                      *XX,                                /* I/O  Correlation matrices                        */
    silk_float                      *xx,                                /* I/O  Correlation values                          */
    const silk_float                noise,                              /* I    Noise energy to add                         */
    const opus_int                  D                                   /* I    Dimension of XX                             */
)
{
    opus_int i;

    for( i = 0; i < D; i++ ) {
        matrix_ptr( &XX[ 0 ], i, i, D ) += noise;
    }
    xx[ 0 ] += noise;
}

#ifndef SILK_SIGPROC_FIX_ARMv4_H
#define SILK_SIGPROC_FIX_ARMv4_H

#undef silk_MLA
static OPUS_INLINE opus_int32 silk_MLA_armv4(opus_int32 a, opus_int32 b,
 opus_int32 c)
{
  opus_int32 res;
  __asm__(
      "#silk_MLA\n\t"
      "mla %0, %1, %2, %3\n\t"
      : "=&r"(res)
      : "r"(b), "r"(c), "r"(a)
  );
  return res;
}
#define silk_MLA(a, b, c) (silk_MLA_armv4(a, b, c))

#endif
